findings.claim: The ticket makes a design choice with a rejected alternative (store images in OpenViking's native per-resource layout D/name/name instead of at the exact URI D/name through a temp folder and fs/mv, which spikes 3-5 showed leaves hidden folders), but no decision record holds it. CLAUDE.md requires one per choice. The component page states the layout but not why the exact-URI route was rejected, or that the operator accepted that markdown image links now point at a folder.
